notes: New exact DOI against baseline unified inventory does not establish new experimental family or absence from secondary ledgers.
Focal endpoints include specified catch and activity outcomes; no pooled synthesis performed. Different trapping or bait mechanisms are coded separately.
Some families appear in multiple publications or previous non-inventory source reviews.
Parent conducted additional comprehensive query and crosswalk. Native metadata and checks for only the two requested datasets are supplied.

records.title: Mitigating light pollution impacts on arthropods based on light-emitting diode properties
records.endpoint: Flight interception captures; ground pitfall activity-density
records.design_and_units: Per forest, 12 experimental LED plots and 2 dark controls; repeat trap weeks over three flight summers and two ground summers. Shared controls across spectra, intensity and shape.
records.family_or_overlap: Swiss WSL, linked samples proven for 2024 report.
records.coordinate_status: Projected plot fields in Moran table; coordinate reference system unconfirmed, incomplete for controls.
records.public_data_or_access: 10.16904/envidat.566; 13 listed files downloaded; consult swiss-envidat/ for integrity manifest and provisional summaries
records.screen_status: eligible manipulated capture; raw recovered; no full-period flight estimate adopted owing to inconsistent plot/treatment and dates

records.title: LED streetlight characteristics alter the functional composition of ground-dwelling invertebrates
records.endpoint: Ground pitfall captures per guild, center and periphery
records.design_and_units: Same network; two summers (2021, 2022); center and peripheral traps nested within lighting plots.
records.family_or_overlap: Swiss WSL; 306/307 eligible 2025/26 center records matched exactly on seven taxon counts and sampling keys. Never pool as independent.
records.coordinate_status: Three named forests; station coordinates require explicit crosswalk.
records.public_data_or_access: 10.16904/envidat.496; complete source CSV downloaded; archive differs in its definition of SumAll.
records.screen_status: eligible linked companion; recoverable functional group counts; does not add experimental family

records.title: Divergent responses of insectivorous bats and flying insects to experimental LED illumination of different spectra
records.endpoint: Nightly flying insect captures; total bat activity showed no overall lighting effect
records.design_and_units: 16 plots (four reserves × control, amber, filtered white and cool white); ≥200 m separation; 3 before nights and 3 during nights; each lit-vs-dark BACI contrast has 4 paired reserve differences.
records.family_or_overlap: Melbourne March 2021; workbook explicitly links the insects to the 2021 JoVE methods paper.
records.coordinate_status: Named four reserves and map; metropolitan coordinates cannot substitute for plot coordinates.
records.public_data_or_access: 10.26181/24311368.v1; complete archived XLSX verified, includes 96 observation rows and a separate grand-total footer; melbourne/.
records.screen_status: eligible manipulated capture; new ecological report on previously held JoVE experiment; descriptive BACI contrasts ready

records.title: Low-Cost Automated Flight Intercept Trap for the Temporal Sub-Sampling of Flying Insects Attracted to Artificial Light at Night
records.design_and_units: Methods paper on the 16 traps; the 2025 source workbook verifies original date/device and sample reuse.
records.public_data_or_access: Public ecology paper and 10.26181/24311368.v1 supply ecological counts; restricted methods full text not used.
records.screen_status: prior methods-paper access hold linked with open ecological report

records.title: Reducing the blue spectrum of artificial light at night minimises insect attraction in a tropical lowland forest
records.endpoint: Insect capture/attraction at lamp; total and taxonomic groups
records.design_and_units: 12 stations ≥100 m apart; white, yellow-filtered, amber-filtered and unlit arms rotated randomly. Each treatment present on 3 nights at each station, 18 nights, 2 sampling intervals/night. 288 samples are repeated measurements.
records.family_or_overlap: Peru rainforest experiment; do not count lamps, source-origin groups or early/late windows as independent studies.
records.coordinate_status: Locations mapped in Supplement Fig S1; forest landscape includes wet and upland environments, which cannot be assigned per trap without matching.
records.public_data_or_access: Paper promises Figshare with no DOI there; Fig 3 reports medians/IQR; raw archive not verified in this pass.
records.screen_status: high-confidence manipulated capture; new report against exact-DOI baseline.

records.title: Tuning the white light spectrum of light emitting diode lamps to reduce attraction of nocturnal arthropods
records.endpoint: Attraction of flying arthropods to lit pan trap vs identical empty housing
records.design_and_units: Three sites; one urban and two rural; lamp treatment moved clockwise among stations between collection nights; multiple lamps share a dark trap; 32 nights in total.
records.family_or_overlap: Los Angeles 2014 pan trap experiment; paired night/site, not independent insects.
records.coordinate_status: Site coordinates in paper; not verified per station.
records.public_data_or_access: Public article, fig 3 means and supplemental route; raw archive not checked.
records.screen_status: high-confidence manipulated capture; new exact-DOI lead

records.title: Off-grid: solar powered LED illumination impacts epigeal arthropods
records.endpoint: Carabid pitfall capture (field experiment); separate activity-arena component
records.design_and_units: 2013 and 2016 used two lines of six traps each per year; zero-to-five lamps rotated across traps each night; 96 trap-nights. Line and trap repeated. Species effects varied.
records.family_or_overlap: Gülpe floodplain overlaps Westhavelland in geography, but distinct portable trap lines, design and years from the later road-light experiment.
records.coordinate_status: Station published 52°44′23″N, 12°15′18″E; this is not the exact position of each trap.
records.public_data_or_access: Primary paper and public PDF; raw file not verified.
records.screen_status: high-confidence manipulated field pitfall captures; keep arena experiment separate

records.title: Artificial light at night inhibits mating in a Geometrid moth
records.endpoint: Winter moth female funnel captures on trunks, male response to pheromone lure; female mating outcome separate
records.design_and_units: Oak trunks with green, red, white or no light; separate male lure experiment. Independent tree/block counts not verified from methods in this pass.
records.family_or_overlap: Do not assume independence from Dutch Light on Nature merely on DOI, or assign same sites without checking.
records.public_data_or_access: Paper, supplementary spectrum/trap photographs; no raw count archive verified.
records.screen_status: manipulated field capture candidate; exact unit and variance hold

records.title: The color of artificial light affects mate attraction in the common glow-worm
records.endpoint: Male glow-worm capture at dummy mating signals, conditional mate attraction
records.design_and_units: 15 stations along a road; 20 nights; five treatments incl. lights off, three stations per treatment per night with randomized rotation; 299 analyzable trap events; yellow and red did not differ significantly from control.
records.family_or_overlap: Related Finnish field projects; verify sites and years before treating e.g. Elgert 2020 as different cohorts.
records.coordinate_status: Road and station area mapped; plot-level coordinates not verified.
records.public_data_or_access: Public author PDF with GLMM tables; raw trap-night file not verified.
records.screen_status: eligible manipulated mate-attraction captures; behavioural endpoint distinct from whole-community capture

records.title: Multi-year experiment shows no impact of artificial light at night on arthropod trophic structure or abundance
records.endpoint: Grass-canopy sweep-net density, total and trophic groups; null overall result
records.design_and_units: Four pairs of 20-m field plots; one randomized lit and one ambient plot per pair, repeated in 2015/16. Near-identical 2016 densities; keep paired design.
records.family_or_overlap: Existing secondary predator screening; Blandy plots overlap Firebaugh firefly/courtship programme.
records.coordinate_status: Named facility; plot coordinates not recovered.
records.public_data_or_access: Figure 1 arm means and SE; public raw file not confirmed.
records.screen_status: eligible area-based density, especially important null; not a new project lead

records.title: Multiple night-time light-emitting diode lighting strategies impact grassland invertebrate assemblages
records.endpoint: Ground spider and beetle pitfall activity-density, day/night samples separated
records.design_and_units: Thirty 16 m² plots in randomized grid, six per each of five arms, including dark; same plots for three years and day/night.
records.family_or_overlap: Existing predator-source lead. Compare plot layout, dates and coordinates with Bennie grassland vegetation study; distinct from outdoor enclosures unless proved identical.
records.coordinate_status: Study-center 50.035159 N, 5.206489 W in author PDF.
records.public_data_or_access: Public author PDF, figure/model evidence; per-plot raw file unconfirmed.
records.screen_status: eligible manipulated pitfall captures; assessed design beyond abstract

records.title: Experimental light at night has a negative long-term impact on macro-moth populations
records.endpoint: Repeated standardized adult macro-moth captures as population-trend proxy
records.design_and_units: Seven Light on Nature sites; experimental treatments vs dark over five years; changes are temporal and do not establish absolute population census.
records.family_or_overlap: Same Dutch infrastructure as Spoelstra and Cieraad; coordinated site subsetting needed.
records.coordinate_status: Use Light on Nature site metadata; not independently geocoded.
records.public_data_or_access: Primary PDF/SI route; no raw archive verified.
records.screen_status: eligible long-term manipulated capture; indirectly referenced already

records.title: Long-term exposure to experimental light affects the ground-dwelling invertebrate community, independent of light spectra
records.location: eight Dutch Light on Nature sites
records.endpoint: Ground pitfall captures by taxon and community; diversity finding was null
records.design_and_units: 8 sites × 4 randomized transects (white/red/green/dark); repeated on/off nights after 3–4 years; 1–2 nested pitfalls per transect.
records.family_or_overlap: Dutch Light on Nature, overlaps 2020 moth and herbivory programme.
records.coordinate_status: Eight sites; infrastructure paper and supplementary metadata.
records.public_data_or_access: 10.34894/YVN4YJ, data, code and metadata; previously identified by project; separate arthropods from molluscs/worms.
records.screen_status: eligible, existing design review; limited/no change in species and beta diversity; distinct capture outcome

records.title: Street lighting has detrimental impacts on local insect populations
records.endpoint: Experimental nocturnal caterpillar activity/feeding proxy; observational caterpillar abundance is a separate component
records.design_and_units: Two unlit grass-margin sites with portable LED and HPS rigs and dark transects, haphazard assignment. Matched pairs for established streetlights were observational. LED disrupted short-term activity, HPS did not show a significant effect.
records.family_or_overlap: Boyes2021 in project; never substitute the matched hedgerow/grass-margin abundance counts for the manipulated activity test.
records.coordinate_status: See repository site metadata; no station coordinates validated here.
records.screen_status: eligible activity component; strong observational reductions not experimental abundance estimates

records.title: Introduction of artificial light at night increases the abundance of predators, scavengers, and parasites in arthropod communities
records.endpoint: Pitfall activity-density by guild and family
records.design_and_units: Added landscape lights, unlit controls and before/during/after phases; repeat trap collections nested in locations.
records.coordinate_status: Existing project documentation; no independent coordinate validation here.
records.public_data_or_access: Publisher article and local existing source; no new download in this search.
records.screen_status: eligible already known; not a new family

records.title: Reducing the fatal attraction of nocturnal insects using tailored and shielded road lights
records.location: Westhavelland and three municipal sites in Germany
records.design_and_units: Controlled field with lit/dark arrays in Westhavelland over 2019–22; 12 luminaires per treatment are not independent regional sites. Municipality retrofit arms are not automatically valid light/dark comparisons.
records.family_or_overlap: Westhavelland field infrastructure: check overlap with riparian studies and avoid pseudoreplication in site array.
records.coordinate_status: Figure 1 maps sites, precise array coordinates not extracted.
records.public_data_or_access: 10.6084/m9.figshare.23773365, AuBe for field array, NaturLicht for municipal sites.
records.screen_status: registered experimental field capture but clustering/lighting cohort limits inference

records.title: The dark side of street lighting: impacts on moths and evidence for the disruption of nocturnal pollen transport
records.endpoint: Ground-level moth abundance index and lamp-height flight activity point in opposite directions.
records.design_and_units: Matched existing lit/unlit sites; lighting not experimentally assigned.
records.family_or_overlap: Keep observational design apart from later portable-rig pollination studies.
records.coordinate_status: See primary methods; no plot coordinates verified.
records.screen_status: observational comparator only; do not add to manipulation-only primary synthesis
